acceptance_predicates.description: GitHub exposes merge-commit as the sole pull-request merge method, disables squash/rebase/auto-merge, and requires web signoff.
One active main-targeted ruleset enforces pull requests, fresh review, resolved threads, strict exact-head checks, verified signatures, Web Flow rejection, and deletion/non-fast-forward prevention.

The contract accepts same-account GitHub approval after independent technical-worker review and does not add authorized-maintainer, second-account, production-authentication, or release-attestation gates.
Missing permission, partial apply, foreign rulesets, stale contexts, and ambiguous API results fail closed without deleting unrelated configuration or claiming success.
The signed local merge procedure still produces exact reviewed-tree two-parent merges and rejects stale refs, wrong trees, unsigned commits, and missing DCO.

definition_of_done: Two consecutive bounded live audits pass against the exact checked-in contract.
Focused settings and merge-integrity fixtures pass on the exact candidate.
An independent technical worker accepts the live configuration and privacy-safe receipt.
AR-1722 records that its external-settings blocker is cleared but remains blocked until the supported unblock capability lands.
